firm_data.firm_description: Bernstein Litowitz Berger & Grossmann LLP is a leading law firm advising institutional investors on issues related to corporate governance, shareholder rights, and securities litigation. Since its founding in 1983, BLB&G has recovered over $40 billion for investors.
notable_facts: The firm has obtained many of the largest securities fraud recoveries in history.
BLB&G has prosecuted seminal cases in which it has achieved precedent-setting corporate governance reforms.
The firm is widely recognized by the media and industry observers for its legal excellence and achievements.

email.subject: AI for BLB&G: Built for firms recovering billions
email.body:
Hi Reid,

Your team's track record speaks for itself: over $40 billion recovered for investors since 1983, with some of the largest securities fraud recoveries in history. That scale of impact demands operational precision across corporate governance, shareholder rights, and securities litigation work.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into New York. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how our ex-lawyer founders built this for firms competing at your level.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
